scope_rule: Same senior domestic league regular-time matches within one season, exact Football-Data Div/date/ordered club names and consistent integer goals. Reject duplicates, retain undefined predictions and markets in coverage. The other fourteen formal scopes have no source panel here.
error_diagnosis: On fitted-period baseline predictions partition all fixtures into exact, mistaken zero status for at least one side, or incorrect positive counts with the same zero status. Tabulate wrongly predicted blank and missed blank team-sides and direction-correct score misses. Check earlier project diagnostic records separately. No target labels may choose the mechanism, cut, prior or thresholds.
fit: Seasons 2019/20, 2020/21, 2021/22 (1920,2021,2122). For each November, January, March and May, issue the full calendar month from one cut at the start of the month. Only previous match dates strictly before cut minus one calendar day may enter strength and shot histories. The last whole day is dropped for unknown timezones and publication delay. Dates are source archive dates. Coefficients fit once to the unique targets of these twelve blocks; no grid or held-out adaptation.
historical_test: Every May match in calendar years 2023, 2024 and 2025, all six named leagues, kickoff date taken from source. On May 1 each season keep only past games dated strictly before April 30 (through April 29). No May result or shot data from these seasons can enter ANY forecast. Baseline and candidate share the full early-calendar roster and fixed historical origin. Original fixture schedule availability and precise ingested clocks are unverified for the historical panel. Build and publish the two forecast/abstention digests before evaluating any selected May outcome. No 2026 outcome is part of this historical test.
anchor: Within each competition and season use prior_team_strength.LeagueStrength prior_goals, unchanged 120-day half-life, team ridge 3, venue ridge 20 and native mean bounds, poisson_matrix shape 31x31. At least 60 prior regular games and both source team names observed. Otherwise abstain both. For a club's prior six same-season league matches, use team shots on target for and opponent shots on target allowed. Both clubs require their previous six to have valid integer HST/AST (zero is legitimate) with oldest record <=90 days at common origin. No substitution for missing matches. Without complete features both arms use the exact anchor.
base: On feature-eligible training team sides calibrate each side's zero probability with a logistic offset logit(exp(-lambda)) plus a shared intercept and slope times log((0.5+average of own six mean SOT for and opponent six mean SOT allowed)/4.5). Ridge 5 on both coefficients (loss plus 0.5*5*sum(coeff^2)), unbounded. Freeze both coefficients for both arms. Each marginal's positive goal probabilities keep the exact anchor conditional distribution. Independent side marginals. No market used for fitting or predicting.
candidate: One additional feature per team side. For each six-count series compute fraction with <=1 shot on target minus exp(-mean)*(1+mean). Average the residuals from own attacks and opponent concession. Fit ONE common bounded coefficient [-4,4] on that residual with the frozen baseline as offset, same logistic loss for the observed zero indicator and ridge 5. Keep intercept, volume coefficient, strength and positive-given-scoring distribution fixed. Zero coefficient is the exact ablation. It estimates shot creation intermittency beyond average volume; SOT count is neither shot quality nor individual keeper skill.
grading: Existing three_arm_model score_picks/top_three_scores on each matrix, unique ordered scores, WDL and O/U marginal decisions. Historical actual line is the named Bet365 2.5 only if both named B365>2.5 and B365<2.5 prices exist; prices are used for line evidence alone, not model inputs. Original fetch/quote clock is unknown; report historical-line result separately. Use real signed two-sided line on clocked-only replay if independently recoverable. Exclude pushes from strict full-win denominator and report all five settlements, per-arm flips, exact-score/zero log loss, date-cluster bootstrap of Top1 paired difference (2000 draws, seed 20261124). All roster and active/coverage subsets published.
clocked_supplement: If feasible retrospectively reconstruct the existing 33 Nov20-21 first comprehensive fixtures only, using exact #69/#70 original IDs/cutoffs, archived team alias proof and same-season six-game shot bytes received and committed prior to cutoff. Use same frozen parameters; missing features revert to baseline. Exclude original R7 IDs/fixture aliases and Nov22+ releases. Dataset was examined in earlier experiments, so it is strictly a previously seen process/coverage check, not another holdout or future evidence. Without sufficient source evidence provide measured coverage without manufacturing picks.
decision: Distinct future evaluation can be proposed only with >=500 eligible paired historical matches, positive Top1 date-cluster 95% lower bound, nonnegative matrix Top3, WDL and strict actual-line full wins and non-worsening full-score log loss on all paired cases. Otherwise retire this recipe, no respecification or tuning on these fixtures. No automatic registration, promotion, delivery, weight change or R7 change. Actual user-visible first, displayed three and preselected 3/3 require a real receipt of both arms.
